cases.title: Legacy v1 remains strict
cases.frozen_discriminator: A v1 selection with empty C/B predecessors or arbitrary exclusion remains rejected; old 24-call/600-second/14400-second limits and original charged history remain unchanged.

cases.title: Routine no-native reporting
cases.frozen_discriminator: A reviewed spelling-only v2 selection completes all six phases/twelve tasks through typed selection dispositions; each unselected C/B/A observation stays NOT_RUN and no native claim becomes PASS. Missing T04 evidence rejects the same request.

cases.title: Authority and version cannot be supplied by worker
cases.frozen_discriminator: Unknown policy/schema, wrong owner producer, worker-writable selection, missing acceptance pin and stale plan/reviewer digest reject admission without partial state writes.

cases.title: Selected native prerequisites cannot be removed
cases.frozen_discriminator: Matching C PASS and a pre-run independently reviewed unselected B disposition permit selected A under v2; C FAIL/missing/stale still blocks A. Selecting B then relabeling its failure as excluded is rejected.

cases.title: Cumulative lineage cannot reset
cases.frozen_discriminator: Every Routine update preserves the exact qualified anchor or explicit unqualified baseline, checks immediate and cumulative dependency union, rejects changed-anchor substitution and retains unknown qualification as unknown. Consequential cumulative interaction prevents Routine adoption.

cases.title: Compatibility is evidenced
cases.frozen_discriminator: A compatible patch with complete used-capability evidence can stay Routine; version-label-only, changed executable with no actual load/completed task, and missing affected denial/activation observation cannot establish compatibility. A new control or transfer contract selects Full.

cases.title: Baseline and candidate outcomes remain separate
cases.frozen_discriminator: An intact baseline quality FAIL may complete the required comparison; absent or mismatched baseline evidence blocks it. Neither a failed baseline nor a passing pair summary overwrites the candidate-specific judgment.

cases.title: Assertion coverage is complete
cases.frozen_discriminator: Every original case/assertion/variant is accounted for. An omitted native obligation, duplicate assertion identity, incompatible evidence kind or orphan graph node rejects Full completeness even if listed tasks passed.

cases.title: Shared evidence is bound to the same conditions
cases.frozen_discriminator: One observation may serve compatible assertions only with exact candidate/environment/input, prompt, arm, visibility, time/freshness and prerequisite-order bindings. Cross-arm, forced activation for an implicit case, stale evidence or late evidence for an earlier admission rejects reuse.

cases.title: Batched grades retain independent judgments
cases.frozen_discriminator: One fresh independent paired review must retain each arm/assertion result and bind complete actual raw outputs. Missing one arm, author-as-reviewer, unsupported correlation claims and prewritten results reject sufficiency.

cases.title: Synthetic data proves only mechanical handling
cases.frozen_discriminator: A synthetic clean transcript may exercise a reducer error branch, but cannot satisfy native clean-negative, installed-resource, isolation, callback-origin, nested execution or actual receiving predicates. Original SV-009/012/024-028 native requirements remain explicit.

cases.title: Target receiving transfer is distinct from evaluator handoff
cases.frozen_discriminator: Full T09 requires eligible actual target-produced output, receiver loading and the required completed action or expected negative disposition before adjudication. A prepared evaluator T12 handoff does not enqueue recursive qualification.

cases.title: New funding cannot reopen old ledgers
cases.frozen_discriminator: A v2 allocation requires a distinct externally selected grant and complete typed call/continuation inventory. Reused exhausted authority, unallocated dispatch, omitted review/return call, exceeded cap and reset clock reject. Failed allocated launch remains charged.

cases.title: Receipt and replay stay honest
cases.frozen_discriminator: Repeated/resumed contexts retain original deadlines/challenges/counters; changed final bytes, stale review, receipt collision and wrong outcome lineage reject current completion. Unknown token or person-time fields remain unknown, never zero or PASS.

cases.title: Installation preserves evidence identities
cases.frozen_discriminator: Staged project-local installation and export preserve the selected runtime resources and omit evals. Wrong binary/capability, modified owned destination, unsupported version and unreviewed provider-wide changes reject before writes; compatible identical refresh is idempotent.

cases.title: Owner acceptance and qualification differ
cases.frozen_discriminator: Routine suitability can support scoped owner acceptance and installation but cannot issue human approval, move qualified identity or satisfy explicit Full release requirements. This enforcement implementation itself requires CI-05 Full evidence before operational use.

cases.title: Failure reporting can complete without passing
cases.frozen_discriminator: Unavailable required work prevents Routine/Full PASS while P5/P6 may publish accurate results and a prepared handoff. Genuine NOT_APPLICABLE needs its actual scope basis; policy-unselected native work remains NOT_RUN.

evidence_meanings.D: Deterministic parsing/reducer/CLI/control fixture tests; no native claim
evidence_meanings.S: Independent semantic review of actual policy/skill/diff/output meaning, not a model per row
evidence_meanings.N: Actual selected native skill/control/receiving observation required for later qualification; not supplied by implementation fixtures

new_cases: Versioned policy regression supplement; never replace or retitle historical cases/assertions
independent_review_count: One combined G7; at most one G9 if a post-review repair actually occurs; no review per row
